output:
To: timeline:rosario.bautista
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

SHE DID IT!!! 🎉🎉🎉 My bestfriend @Lorna Villaruz got her NMC PIN today and she is officially a UK registered nurse!!! I am at clinic and I cannot even type properly, my hands are shaking haha 😭😭

Lorna and me trained together in nursing school in Iloilo, capping ceremony 1996. Two skinny girls with the same hairstyle and the same big dream 😂 Every night in the dorm we polished our white shoes until they shine like mirror, and every night Lorna borrowed my polish. Never once bought her own lol. Lorna I am still waiting for you to pay me back for all those years, I will accept dried mangoes 😂

When I left for UK in 2004 she cried at the airport and said "susunod ako, I will follow you." And I said ok, I will wait. Then she went to Riyadh, then Dubai, almost 18 years working so hard over there. And every year for 20 years I am telling her, come na, come to Liverpool!! And every year she say next year, next year. Well, 22 years later, HERE SHE COMES 😂🙏

When she did the OSCE in Nottingham I sent her a photo of the rain so she knows exactly what she is getting into haha. And still she said yes. That is true friendship.

She lands on 14 January and starts work on 25 January!!! Ward 7 you are so lucky, I am telling you now. Lorna is the best nurse I know. Always so calm, even when everything is going crazy around her, and the patients love her. You will see. They will ask for her by name.

For the first month she is staying with us in our spare room (Ben say ok, but I think he only say ok because she promise to bring Bicol pili for him 😂). I already have the thick duvet ready because you will freeze, anak. Lorna please bring a PROPER coat, not the cute one, the proper one. Liverpool wind is no joke, it will turn your umbrella inside out on the first day. If you don't have, we will go to TK Maxx together, my treat 😘

And to all my kabayan here, please welcome my sister from another mother!! Lorna, welcome to our Filipino family here in Liverpool. You will have so many titas and ates here you will not know what to do with them haha. Next Christmas you are coming to our Christmas party, and Simbang Gabi next year we go together, all nine nights, no excuses. I already told Ben he is driving us 😂

From polishing white shoes in Iloilo to working in the same city again after all these years. Thank you Lord, you really answer prayers in your own time.

So proud of you Lorna ko. You worked so hard for this. See you at Manchester airport, I will be the one crying and holding the big sign 😭❤️🇵🇭🇬🇧

#SusunodAko #FinallyHere #WelcomeToLiverpool #ProudBestfriend
